title: Israeli Strikes Kill Seven Across Gaza, Destroy Medical Supply Warehouse in Deir al-Balah
detail: Israeli strikes across Gaza killed at least seven Palestinians, including a strike that destroyed a medicine warehouse belonging to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, next to tents sheltering displaced families — officials said the warehouse was a lifeline for the central Gaza region's medical supplies. The strikes came one day after Hamas and other Palestinian factions signed the Board of Peace disarmament agreement that the US billed as a breakthrough toward ending the war, and brought the weekend death toll to 26 including women and children. Israel has continued strikes despite the October 2025 ceasefire, which by this point had killed more than 1,200 Palestinians since it took effect.
